title: Valibot at the boundaries
description: Where and how ShelfKit parses data it did not produce.
notes: Parse at the boundary, once: a GraphQL `JSON` value, `localStorage`, an SSE message, a request body. Code past the boundary takes the parsed type.
The shared schemas are in `packages/schema`; use them instead of writing a second one.
Mark the parsing function with a `BOUNDARY:` comment saying what arrives unparsed.
